comment: The table associates data governance, quality, and audit mainly with registries, the Terminology Service, LIMR, and SGI. Governance and audit apply to all DPI-H components, and clinical-data quality cannot be governed solely through metadata components.

citation.caption: Table 2.2
citation.raw: §2.2.1 p.28 l.Table 2.2, “Data governance, quality, and audit”

public.text: The table associates data governance, quality, and audit mainly with registries, the Terminology Service, LIMR, and SGI. Governance and audit apply to all DPI-H components, and clinical-data quality cannot be governed solely through metadata components.
public.suggestedRevision: State that these are architecture-wide responsibilities supported by component-level stewardship, provenance, audit, validation, quality rules, monitoring, and remediation processes.
